editionLabel: Eagle-Gryphon English public rulebook, Explor8 ©2022, linked from the Deluxe edition
firstPlayerRule: Agree on a method for choosing the starter. Give the chosen player the President of the Senate pawn; they begin the Ambassador phase.
houseFallback: Your group may agree to choose randomly; the rulebook leaves the selection method to everyone’s agreement.
clarifications: Before play, players choose Starting tiles counterclockwise, beginning with the person to the starter’s right. This is a setup draft, separate from the clockwise Ambassador turns.
The President’s Office action can change who starts the next round.
